label: Bible Study
prompt: Pleasant words are as an _____, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verse: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
note: Kind words as health food — sweet going down, and good for the bones.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples _____, when they saw the Lord.
verse: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
note: Behind locked doors, Jesus showed them His hands and side, and fear turned to gladness.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's _____; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verse: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
note: Jonah's own book says 'great fish,' but the KJV in Matthew says whale — and Jesus makes the three days a sign of his own.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is _____ you.
verse: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
note: Asked when the kingdom would come, Jesus told the Pharisees to stop scanning the horizon for it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a _____?
verse: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
note: Eliab mocked his kid brother on the battlefield; David answered, 'Is there not a cause?' — then went out to face Goliath.
